mods.name: Lodestore
mods.description: Unified storage: backpacks, crates, and networked storage built on Fabric's Storage<ItemVariant> transfer API.

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Add the MIT LICENSE file by @alexfricker in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/24
* Add community files for the public repository by @alexfricker in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/25
* Document how an issue moves through its labels by @alexfricker in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/28
* Document milestones and the project board by @alexfricker in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/29
* Give tiers 2, 4 and 6 upgrade slots, and add the compress, disenchant and repair upgrades by @alexfricker in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/31
* Publish releases and the gallery to Modrinth by @alexfricker in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/32
* Fix the release workflow's Modrinth guard, and say why a project lookup fails by @alexfricker in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/33
* Give the crates new skins, a centred label with no count, and six-way placement by @alexfricker in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/34
* Redraw the network blocks, and re-shoot the Modrinth gallery with the devices in view by @alexfricker in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/35
* Let the interface box hand out what is clicked by @alexfricker in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/36
* Give the connection block an indicator that lights while items pass, and a copper recipe by @alexfricker in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/37
* Bump org.junit:junit-bom from 5.11.4 to 6.1.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/26
* Bump gradle-wrapper from 9.5.1 to 9.8.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/27
* Hexagon upgrade sprites and a 3D, directional deposit box by @alexfricker in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/38

## New Contributors
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/pull/26

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/fricker-studios/lodestore/compare/v0.2.2...v0.3.0
